description:
Exciting LED Lights for Extra Fun
The KS2 electric scooter comes with 4.7-inch self-lighting wheels that flash while riding. These vibrant LED lights not only add excitement but also increase visibility when riding in low-light conditions. Your child will love the dazzling lights as they zoom around.
35W Motor for Safe Speed
Equipped with a 35W motor, the KS2 electric scooter provides a smooth, controlled ride with a maximum speed of 5mph. The motor ensures your child enjoys their ride safely while maintaining fun speeds. Total charging time is approximately 2 hours, making it convenient to charge at home or on the go, and a single charge can provide up to 9 km of driving range.
Adjustable Handlebar & Lightweight Design
Our KS2 scooter features an adjustable handlebar height (ranging from 29.5" to 33.5") to accommodate children as they grow. It has a lightweight design, weighing just 12lbs, making it easy to carry and store when not in use. It also folds for convenience, so it can easily fit in a car trunk or a closet.
Designed for Young Riders’ Comfort and Safety
With a maximum weight capacity of 121lbs, the electric scooter is suitable for children from 3 to 6 years old. Whether your child is riding for fun or commuting, the scooter is designed for stability and ease of use.
The Best Gift & Excellent Customer Support
The KS2 electric scooter is the perfect gift for kids, ideal for boys, girls, and teenagers. It’s incredibly easy to assemble—just a few screws, and your scooter is ready to ride! If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us, and we’ll be happy to assist you.
